purpose: Loyalty Red series — Guan Yu themed enamel pin and ceramic cup
prompt:
Product variant photograph for 脸谱潮 LIANPU CHAO — "忠义红 Loyalty Red" series featuring Guan Yu theme.

Scene: Two products on a dark ink-black #1a1a2e surface with dramatic lighting:
1. A round enamel pin (35mm) — gold #d4a843 metal border, cinnabar-red #e8433f as dominant fill color. The pin design shows a deconstructed Guan Yu opera mask: phoenix eyes (凤眼), red face, symmetrical pattern with bold thick outlines. Small gold accents for the crown/headdress element.
2. A white ceramic mug with underglaze cinnabar-red #e8433f opera mask pattern — the Guan Yu face wraps around the cup, with gold #d4a843 line details. Handle visible.

The red color dominates 30-40% of the visual area. Gold accents provide luxury feel. The deconstructed mask pattern is clearly recognizable as Guan Yu — phoenix eyes are the key identifier.

Style: Guochao illustration — bold flat colors, thick outlines, no gradients. Product photography quality with real material textures (enamel gloss, ceramic glaze). Dramatic side lighting creating depth. Background is ink-black #1a1a2e for maximum contrast with the red products.
